1a.speaker: Gillian

1e.speaker: Gillian
1e.en: Just Gillian, Mika. Call me Gillian.

23.speaker: Mika
23.en: Chief, I've brought Mr. Gillian Seed.

25.en: I'm Gillian Seed, from the 17th Special Forces Unit.

26.en: Seed, I've heard how well you did in special military training. I want you to put those talents to work on this assignment.

I want you to put|those talents to|work on this|assignment.

27.en: Your file says you have amnesia. Has your memory returned?

28.speaker: Gillian
28.en: That's right. The military found me three years ago. I remember nothing from before that.

29.speaker: Mika
29.en: You had a wife, didn't you?

2a.speaker: Gillian
2a.en: Yes, but we're separated now. Neither of us has any memories. How could we make it work?
cards: Yes, but we're|separated now.|Neither of us has|any memories.

2c.speaker: Chief
2c.en: You should understand your assignment now.

2d.speaker: Chief
2d.en: This is your JUNKER card. It identifies you as a JUNKER. It grants you a JUNKER's special authority.
cards: This is your JUNKER|card. It identifies|you as a JUNKER.

2e.speaker: Gillian
2e.en: I see. Like a police badge.

2f.speaker: Chief
2f.en: It's not much, but here's money for your investigation expenses.

31.speaker: Chief

33.speaker: Chief
33.en: Get your JUNKER equipment from Harry, our mechanic.

37.speaker: Gillian
37.en: No, this is the first time.

38.speaker: Harry
38.en: Then I must be imagining it.

39.speaker: Harry
39.en: I know. Shall we call the Navigator I built just for you? Hey, Metal Gear!

3b.speaker: Metal Gear
3b.en: Yes. Gillian, I'm Metal Gear Mk. II, and I'll be your support. Nice to meet you.

3f.en: He's blushing. I based his shape on Metal Gear, the machine that terrified the world at the end of the twentieth century. But this one was developed for peaceful use.

40.en: Oh, right. Don't rush me. I've got it ready.

41.speaker: Harry
41.en: This is the Blaster, a JUNKER's weapon. It has a feedback system. It responds to the speed of your reflexes. Its performance depends on who's using it.

44.speaker: Harry
44.en: Isn't it? Nothing like the ray guns the military uses. Super engineering plastic, carbon fiber and ceramic. So temperature changes won't affect it. It's ergonomically designed for function and firepower. Well, do you like it?

46.en: Jean Jack Gibson is calling. I'll put him through.

4d.en: We'll use this Tricycle for investigations.
